note.v.orders: Suitcase maker: the man in black's suitcases have blank tags. Lisa's is small; the combination is «the day she went away» (register of the dead: 24 October 1974).
v.tagBlank: A small suitcase, with a luggage tag tied to the handle. The tag is blank.
v.tagBlankLens: The tag is blank. But the paper is marked... with the UV lens on the torch I might read it.
v.tagName: On the tag, in faint pencil, there's a name: «{name}».
v.tagOther: Somebody else's dream is inside. I let it sleep.
v.caseDown: It's hers. I take the ladder and bring it down to the bench. It's the only red thing in here.
v.caseLocked: Lisa's little suitcase. A lock with a keyhole and a six-number combination.
v.keyIn: The key from Lisa's diary turns in the lock. Now the combination: six numbers.
v.comboTitle: The combination: the day she went away
v.caseOpen: Click. The suitcase opens. There's no bottom inside: there's light. And a song I know.
v.shelves: Suitcases of every size, each with its blank tag. From one comes a soft snore.
v.apron: The suitcase maker's apron, on a nail. A name is stitched on it: Arturo. Nothing else of him is left.
v.trunk: A huge trunk. When I touch it, someone inside knocks three times. I don't open it.
uv.v1: Mine is on the high shelf, on the right.
hint.v.orders: The order book, on the bench: it says how to find me.
hint.v.tags: The high shelf, on the right: read the suitcases' tags.
hint.v.key: The suitcase has a lock: the key you found in my diary.
hint.v.combo: The day I went away: it was in the register of the dead, in the sacristy. Day, month, year: six numbers.
v.dream1: I'm inside. It's our room, the one we had as children.
v.dream2: The ceiling is the lining of the suitcase. Suitcases float like thoughts.
v.dream3: Lisa is at the window. She's still a little girl.
v.lisaHum1: Lisa hums, looking out. A Sunday that never ends.
v.lisaHum2: I call her, but she can't hear me. Her hair is loose: something is missing.
v.d1: It's me, Lisa. I've come to take you home.
v.l2: You're grown up. You have Dad's hands.
v.d2: Dad is free. The others too. You're the only one left.
v.l3: I know. I heard them go, one by one.
v.l4: But he's coming. This suitcase is his. And so am I, he says.
v.doll: Lisa's doll. I broke its arm once. She stuck it back on with tape.
v.beds: Our two beds. Mine is made. Hers isn't: she never made it.
v.window: Outside there's the river, and Sunday. Always the same Sunday.
v.door: I open the door of the room... and on the other side there's nothing.
hint.v.ribbon: My ribbon, Diego. You have it.
fin.m1: What a lovely family. What a lovely suitcase.
fin.m2: The deal was clear, boy: I take your memories, you bring my things back. All of them. This one too.
fin.d1: I've taken my memories back. The deal is off.
fin.m3: Then I'll take them again. Close your eyes: tomorrow you won't even know you had a sister. No more pain.
fin.choiceTitle: The man in black holds out his hand
fin.choiceText: «Forget, Diego. Leave her to me, and you'll never hurt again.»
fin.bad1:
Diego closes his eyes.
When he opens them he's on the train, and doesn't know why he has been crying.
fin.bad2:
At the Emporium, on the top shelf, there's one more little red suitcase.
The tag is blank.
fin.bad3:
That's not how it ends.
Lisa is still looking at you.
fin.again: Diego. Look at me. Don't leave me here again.
fin.d2: No. Lisa is coming with me.
fin.m4: Broken deals are paid for, boy. With time. I have plenty.
fin.l1: No he hasn't. All he has is that hourglass. Turn it over, Diego!
fin.flipText: The man in black's hourglass: turn the phone over to turn it.
fin.l3: It's over. His time is up.
fin.l4: I can't go back, Diego. But I can go on, now. Thanks to you.
fin.l5: Remember me. Never forget me again.
fin.end1:
The suitcase closes by itself.
Inside, now, there's only a sunny Sunday.
fin.end2:
Rocca del Castello, 24 October.
The bells of St Michael's ring out. Nobody knows who pulled the ropes.
fin.end3:
At the Emporium, on the pedestal with Lisa's name, there's a white ribbon.
The counter is empty. On the chair, a top hat full of sand.
fin.end4:
Diego takes the train again. This time he remembers everything.
And for the first time, remembering doesn't hurt.
fin.end5:
COSE PREZIOSE

The end.
Thank you for playing.
fin.after: There's nobody here now. Only the light from the window.
fin.door: The door of our room. Now it opens.
hint.fin.after: It's over, Diego. You can go.
diary.finale.title: Lisa
diary.finale.text:
I found Lisa in her suitcase, inside a Sunday that never ended.
The man in black came to take her back. I said no.
I turned his hourglass, and his time ran out.
Lisa has gone on. I remember her.
emp.final1: The counter is empty. On his chair there's only the top hat, full of sand.
emp.final2: The Emporium is just an old shop now. Dust and shelves.
map.valigiaDone: The Suitcase Maker's. The window is empty. On the door, a sign: «Closed for good».
ui.sensor.jump: Jump with the phone in your hand
v.fall1: The floor creaks... and it's gone. Below there's only darkness.
v.fallText: You're falling! In dreams you wake with a jolt: jump, with the phone in your hand.
v.fallAgain: Still falling. It's always the same dream: I fall and never reach the bottom.
v.fall2: A jolt. I'm on my bed, in our room.
v.fall3: I had this nightmare every night as a child. Lisa held my hand until it passed.
v.fly1: I walk towards her, but the room stretches. The more I walk, the further the window goes.
v.fly2: My feet leave the floor. I'm flying, like in the other dream I always had.
v.flyText: Tilt the phone like wings and fly among the suitcases to Lisa, at the window. Without sensors, drag Diego with your finger.
v.flyFail: The suitcases knock into me and I sink down again. Lisa is still far away. I try again.
v.fly3: I land beside her, softly. Lisa doesn't turn round.

ora.metronome: The metronome is beating like mad. The weight is at the bottom of the rod: the lower it is, the faster it goes.
ora.metronomeHow: The weight slides along the rod: higher is slower. It has to keep time with the heartbeat I hear in the stethoscope: the calm, steady one, ba-dum, ba-dum.
ora.metronomeSlower: Slower... the thump-thump slows down with it.
ora.metronomeStop1: The weight reaches the top. The rod stops. Silence.
ora.metronomeStop2: The hearts fall quiet too. A silence so clean it's frightening.
ora.metronomeAfter: The metronome keeps time with the heart I heard in the stethoscope. And every clock with it.
ora.mantelNoise: A mantel clock. There may be something inside, but with all this pounding I can't hear a thing.
ora.ticketsAfter1: He isn't talking about clocks. He's talking about hearts.
ora.ticketsAfter2: «Stopped.» «Silenced.» As if he were mending an alarm clock.
ora.stairsLocked: The door to the stairs. Locked. On the other side, a thick, muffled silence.
ora.windTrain: Turn the barrel with your finger, in a circle, until the movement starts.
ora.trainRuns: The movement starts. But it doesn't go tick-tock: it goes thump-thump. Like a heart. And the drawer under the bench springs.
ora.steth: Ottavio's stethoscope. A clockmaker has no need of one, unless he listens to something else. I take it.
ora.stethNeedTrain: There's nothing to listen to here. The movement is still.
ora.stethListen: I put the stethoscope to the movement. Thump-thump. And beneath it, tiny, a click. In the drawer. But to hear it I have to keep quiet.
ora.silenceText: Silence. Don't speak, don't move, hold your breath: five seconds.
ora.silenceDone: Click. Click. Click. The drawer under the bench opens, in time with the iron heart.
ora.silenceAfter: The iron heart beats. I don't need to listen any more.
ora.roomKey: A key with a tag, in a steady hand: «Silent room».
item.roomkey.desc: The key to the stairs door, at L'Ora Ferma.
ora.ottavioLook: Ottavio Sala. Asleep... or pretending. Two wax plugs in his ears.
ora.ott1: Don't speak... silence is the only clean thing I have left.
ora.ott2: I can hear yours. Thump-thump, thump-thump. Too alive. Too loud.
ora.ott3: Go away, before I have to stop that one too.
ora.ottAngry: He says nothing. He presses his hands to his ears, and stares at me.
ora.ottAfter: Ottavio is gone. Only the marks of his feet on the padded floor.
ora.musicbox: A music box, on the chest of drawers. The wood is worn where a child's hands used to touch it.
ora.musicboxEarly: A music box. With him staring at me, I don't dare touch anything.
ora.musicboxWind: The key is in place. Turn it with your finger, in a circle, to wind it.
ora.lull1: That tune... they played it when I was afraid of the dark. It wasn't noise. It was... love.
ora.lull2: I silenced everything so as not to hear anything any more... and I shut this out too.
ora.lull3: Go on up. The clock is up there.
ora.musicboxAfter: The music box is silent. But the room no longer seems so empty.
ora.photoClara: A photo in a silver frame: a little girl on the workshop stool. On the back: «Clara, 9 December 1961». His daughter. She left home years ago.
ora.bedOtt: Ottavio's bed. The pillow holds the shape of his head.

radio.log:
12 June 1973 — interference on the Phonola. In it, the Contis arguing. I hear them as if they were here.
20 June — Morandi sings while he shaves. Ferri talks to his plates.
3 July — the merchant says with his little radio I will hear EVERYONE. He's right.
August — I don't sleep any more. The voices don't switch off even when I switch off.
September — under all the voices there's another one. Higher. It doesn't talk to the village: it talks to ME.
October — I call it the Supreme Voice. From the roof, with the right antenna, I'll hear it.
radio.logAfter: First the neighbours, then the whole village. And in the end one voice alone, above all the others.
radio.wall1: The wall to the neighbours'. Pencil circles everywhere, with dates. One has been gone over again and again: «12/6 !!».
radio.wall2: Nello put something here to listen. I'd need his microphone.
radio.wallAfter: The microphone is still on the wall. From the other side, nothing now.
radio.amp: An amplifier with a little needle meter, and headphones. There's a free socket for a microphone.
radio.ampVu: The needle moves with what the microphone hears. The higher it goes, the clearer the voices.
radio.micOn1: I put the microphone on the wall and plug the cable into the amplifier. Hiss. And under it, voices.
radio.micOn2: I slide it across the wall: where the voices are clearer, the needle rises.
radio.micFar: Nothing here, just hiss. The needle doesn't move.
radio.micCloser: Something... but it's muddled. I'm close.
radio.micHere: Here. The circle gone over again and again. The voices are clear, but my own breathing drowns them. I have to keep quiet.
radio.silenceText: Total silence: don't speak or make a sound for a few seconds.
radio.nb1: «Three o'clock. There he is, Sartori. Every night the same.»
radio.nb2: «Hear that? He moves the bed. It scrapes on the floor. Then that floorboard that creaks: he lifts it... and puts it back.»
radio.nb3: «And then the window. Up on the roof with his radios till dawn.»
radio.nb4: «I don't sleep any more, Gino. I don't sleep any more.»
radio.nbAfter1: He moves the bed, lifts a floorboard, puts it back. Then he opens the window.
radio.nbAfter2: Under the bed there's something he needs to get out.
note.board: The neighbours heard Nello every night: he moves the bed, lifts a floorboard, puts it back, then opens the window.
radio.bedMoved: I move the bed. It scrapes on the floor, just as they said. Under it, one board is paler than the others.
radio.boardHint: A floorboard, where the bed used to be. It's loose.
radio.boardUp: The board comes up with a creak. Underneath, in the dust, a window handle.
radio.boardSee: In the hole under the board there's a window handle.
radio.handleTaken: The window handle. He took it off himself, so nobody would follow him onto the roof.
radio.bedAfter: The bed moved, the board up. The hole in the floor is empty.
radio.windowNoHandle: The window has no handle: just a square spindle where it should be. It won't open like this.
radio.windowFit: I have the window handle: I fit it on the spindle.
radio.tunerOff: The tuner. Without the receiver on, it's no use.
radio.tunerHow: The big tuning knob: turning it changes the frequency on the receiver's dial.
radio.tunerDone: The tuner is on the signal's frequency. Better not touch it.

radio.keyDead: The key is still dark. The voice is asking for something: «higher».
